infobox.usage: Unlocks apartment 20 on the fifth floor of the Zmeisky 5 building on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Zmeisky 5 apartment 20 key (Zm apt. 20) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the apartments at Zmeisky Alley 5.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to apartment 20 on the fifth floor of the Zmeisky 5 building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Sport bag
- Loose loot (Energy elements, Electronics, Provisions, Valuables)
